title: Automated Questionnaire Response & Evidence Bundling API for Compliance Requests
creator: Sofia Zhang
description: Create a customer-facing and API-driven workflow that automates responses to standard compliance questionnaires, assembles required evidence (logs, residency proofs, DPAs), and produces downloadable audit bundles. Targets: accelerate audit response time, reduce manual engineering effort, and provide auditable provenance for bundled artifacts.
background: Customers frequently submit questionnaires and audit requests asking for residency controls, retention policies, DPA copies, and evidence of configuration. Responding today is manual: SEs pull logs, engineering compiles proofs, and legal provides DPAs. This causes long lead times and inconsistent artifacts. We need a robust intake + automation layer that integrates with Console, Dedicated, and Private deployments.
goals: Expose a lightweight Compliance Requests API for automated intake and status tracking
Support templated questionnaire responses (SOC2/ISO/Custom) with derived answers from configuration and telemetry
Bundle verifiable artifacts: DPA PDF, data residency manifest, retention policy snapshot, audit logs, access logs and change history
Provide a single-click export (zip) and a shareable link with time-limited access
Integrate with existing Console request UI and trigger human review flows when automated confidence is low
success_metrics: Median time to first response for audit requests reduced from 5 business days to <24 hours
Percentage of questionnaire items auto-resolved >= 70% for standard templates
Number of manual engineering hours spent per request reduced by 60%
Customer satisfaction for audit readiness flows >= 4.5/5 in post-delivery surveys
scope_in_scope: Questionnaire templates for common requests (DPA, SOC2 scoping, data residency confirmation)
Compliance Requests API (submit, status, download bundle)
Evidence bundling service that collects artifacts across internal stores and formats them with provenance metadata
Console UI: request submission form, templated response preview, admin review & approve flows
Short-lived secure share links for bundle downloads, with audit logging
out_of_scope: Full trust/legal negotiation for modified DPAs (legal to handle separately)
Generating new attestation reports (we will package existing reports only)
Custom integrations with third-party compliance management vendors in phase 1
milestones: 2026-04-20: GA with Console integration and support documentation
acceptance_criteria: API: POST /compliance-requests accepts standard templates and returns request id and status
Automation: System auto-populates >= 70% of answers for DPA and residency template using config + telemetry
Bundling: Generated zip contains a manifest.json with SHA256 hashes and timestamps for each artifact
Security: Download link enforces token expiry and logs access events in audit log
Console: Request creation and admin approval flows are wired and accessible to customers with appropriate RBAC
risks: Automated answers may be incorrect for custom or heavily modified tenant configurations; must default to human review
Collecting some evidence for Private/on-prem deployments may require agent work or customer-provided exports
Legal acceptance of packaged DPA copies varies by customer region and may require tailoring
Data sensitivity: bundling logs must redact PII or exclude secrets to avoid exposure
notes: Design decision 2026-03-05: bundle format will be a signed zip with manifest and optional PDF cover letter
Trade-off: initial PII redaction will follow a deny-list approach; plan to add allow-list later after pilot feedback
Implementation note: reuse existing reporting exporter (ENG-2048) for log pulls to speed development
Pilot customers identified: FinTechCo, HealthStartup, RetailCorp
